scope: Corollary 3.6 (Spherical stability) of the manuscript “The critical dimension for one-phase Bernoulli minimizers” (preprints/The-critical-dimension-for-one-phase-Bernoulli-minimizers-September-24-2026/The-critical-dimension-for-one-phase-Bernoulli-minimizers-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 367 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eb1a535a1d8a9dc4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every real function v smooth up to the regular boundary of the working component Ω ⊂ S5, with compact support in its closure away from the tips if present, Z ∂Ω Hv2 dσ ≤ Z Ω |∇v|2 + 4v2  dV. (3.26) The trace of v on the regular boundary is arbitrary.
